question: What capacity per gram of sulfur did the cathode deliver at cycle 1500 at 1C, and what share is that of the reversible capacity it showed at 1C in the rate test?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE kind IN ('line','ocr') AND (text ILIKE '%1500%' OR text ILIKE '%1C%' OR text ILIKE '%mAh%' OR text ILIKE '%cycle%') ORDER BY page, id
SELECT id, figure_id, text FROM atoms WHERE kind LIKE '%ocr%' AND (text ILIKE '%1500%' OR text ILIKE '%1C%' OR text ILIKE '%mAh%' OR text ILIKE '%cycle%') ORDER BY id

SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE page=5 AND id IN ('p5.L98','p5.L99','p5.L100','p5.L101','p5.L102','p5.L103','p5.L104','p5.L105','p5.L106','p5.L87','p5.L86','p5.L88','p5.L85') ORDER BY id
SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE page=5 AND kind='line' AND id BETWEEN 'p5.L84' AND 'p5.L110' ORDER BY id

SELECT fixed1(100.0 * CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM atoms WHERE id='p5.L103'), '([0-9]+) mAh', 1) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM atoms WHERE id='p5.L87'), '([0-9]+) mAh', 1) AS DOUBLE)) AS share

SELECT 100.0 * CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM atoms WHERE id='p5.L103'), '([0-9]+) mAh', 1) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM atoms WHERE id='p5.L87'), '([0-9]+) mAh', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS share, regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM atoms WHERE id='p5.L103'), '([0-9]+) mAh', 1) AS cyc, regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM atoms WHERE id='p5.L87'), '([0-9]+) mAh', 1) AS rev
